convert_torchvision_to_d2: run the script to convert a torchvision ResNet .pth model to a Detectron2 .pkl format
rename_layer_keys: run the script to rename torchvision layer keys like layer1 to res2 for Detectron2 compatibility
rename_bn_keys: run the script to rename torchvision bn1 keys to conv1.norm format for Detectron2
convert_downsample_keys: run the script to rename torchvision downsample.0 keys to shortcut for Detectron2
dump_pickle_model: run the script to dump the converted model weights as a Detectron2 pickle file
